title: CIA shut down the reverse-engineering effort in 1989 after no progress

tellings.quote: all I do know is I was given a firm hey in 1989 the CIA shut it all down because nobody us and we know the other companies that we had been found out from our customer didn't make any progress after several decades

plain: According to the physicist Eric W. Davis, the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, shut down a secret effort to reverse-engineer recovered craft in 1989, because neither its own people nor the companies working on it had made any progress after several decades. Davis says he was told this firmly by someone else and is passing it on. He tells it because it would mean a long-running government program to copy unknown technology existed and failed.
